_form_note: Student_Attrition (Zoho form 'Student – Attrition'), built from Zoho_To_CHEDS_(23).ds field definitions + the push workflow 'push_api_production2' (POST .../Integration/Students/Attrition) + the four thisapp.Dropdown_Fields functions it calls (Gender, Student_Level_Code, Attrition_Category, Attrition_Reason). Raw column names = HEDB 'Student- Attrition' Database Field Names. institutionCode is hardcoded to 141 in the workflow, but Institution_code is a mandatory field on the form so it's still imported. Attrition_Reason uses 'value_map_by': the same code (TR) means different things under different categories, so the reason is resolved per row using that row's Attrition_Category -- and a reason that doesn't belong to its category is flagged rather than silently mapped. 2026 reason codes TI, TRP, TRM are mapped to the new picklist labels added on the Zoho form.
